title: 2024 Nestor Cortes Jr. #51  Topps Series One Foil New York Yankees

descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Topps Series 1 trading card featuring Nestor Cortes Jr. (#51) of the New York Yankees. This foil parallel variety card is manufactured by Topps for the Major League Baseball (MLB) season of 2024. It is a single sports trading card.
